source: Native C controls; not a Rust or whole-Copy acceptance
key_result: Rejected pending-control after a pre-held WRITE_DAC plus READ_CONTROL handle restored full access after freeze, inserted a foreign stream, and automatic deletion removed it.
rejected: Read-only descriptor at creation strips WRITE_DAC (0x13019f granted versus 0x17019f requested), so restoration cannot succeed.
MAXIMUM_ALLOWED/full-access requests do not fix missing WRITE_DAC in those controls.
Read-plus-WRITE_DAC alone allows a second permission writer.
Setting extended ON_CLOSE|DELETE on a non-on-close creation returns ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED (50).

Freeze-after-creation retains permission capabilities acquired before freeze. A permission-only handle without READ_CONTROL failed restoration; adding READ_CONTROL demonstrated the data-loss interleave.
